caption:
One short dua for every student

Allah ends this verse with a dua to say: “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.” Carry it into every class, every page and every exam today.

Surah Taa-Haa 20:114

Say it once before you open your books today.

#studentlife #duaforknowledge #seekknowledge #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
alt_text: So Exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign. Do not hasten to [recite] the Qur’an before its revelation to you is concluded, and say, “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.” (Surah Taa-Haa 20:114)
theme: knowledge / dua for increase in knowledge
